question: A typist takes 40 minutes to type 4 pages. How many pages will he type in 90 minutes?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Pages ∝ Time

4 pages → 40 min ⇒ 1 page → 10 min

In 90 min ⇒ 90 ÷ 10 = 9 pages

Direct ratio: (90/40) × 4 = 9

**∴ Answer = 9 pages**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

40 min → 4 pages

**Formula used:**

Pages ∝ Time ⇒ Pages = (Time × Pages₁) ÷ Time₁

**Calculation:**

⇒ Required pages = (90 × 4) ÷ 40

⇒ = 360 ÷ 40

⇒ = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9 pages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportion

If one quantity increases, the other increases proportionally

Unitary Method

Find value of one unit, then scale up

Rate Concept

Typing rate = pages per minute

Quick Tip

Use ratio: (New time / Old time) × Pages
